question: Should this PR reset existing Android Installed Apps opt-ins and ship the added Data Safety upload path as the approved Google Play privacy rollout?
rationale: The code fix is plausible and well-proven, but accepting the upgrade reset and Play compliance materials is a maintainer privacy/release decision that source review cannot finalize.

options.title: Approve privacy rollout
options.body: Accept the legacy opt-in reset, confirm the Play Console/privacy-policy materials, refresh the branch against current main, and proceed toward merge.

options.title: Adjust disclosure or release flow first
options.body: Require wording, placement, or Data Safety workflow changes before merge, then repeat emulator and release-lane proof.

options.title: Pause until Play materials are ready
options.body: Keep the PR open as a draft until the Data Safety CSV, Play Console state, and privacy policy are ready to ship together.

recommendation.title: Approve privacy rollout
recommendation.body: Accept the legacy opt-in reset, confirm the Play Console/privacy-policy materials, refresh the branch against current main, and proceed toward merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Android runtime/settings ownership and broader repository ownership make this the strongest available routing candidate for the privacy and upgrade decision.
